title: console boot: the language seed's me/localization waits 500-790 ms for the eager bundle; start it at parse time beside discovery
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CZrgaiMgTJCnswR6jQ

Filing gate: ③ a measured finding of the #35455 dev (os-dev-report 7012178512, item 1), measured on `origin/main` `92121196` with the built console, 12 loads. It is a child of #35455 (console first-screen round trips, p1) and is nested under it.
Reader: `domain:ui` (console boot, `ui/apps/console`). Suggested grade: p1, the parent's grade (objectstack-ai/cloud#4563 step 2 waits on the family).
Dedupe: `language seed parse time`, `me/localization bundle wait`, `startEarlyDiscovery localization`. Only #35455 matches; the eager-bundle shrink itself is #33581.

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：控制台首屏更快出现，取界面语言的请求不再等整包脚本下载完。
- 为什么做：托管环境打开页面要 9–10 秒，这是首屏请求串行里的第一段等待。
- 出错会怎样：语言判断规则不变；出错时界面语言可能先用默认再切换，撤回即可。
- 要你做什么：无。

## Facts

- The first module-issued call (the seed's `GET /api/v1/auth/me/localization`) leaves at 503-790 ms after navigation, after 105 eager JS files (6.57 MB raw / 1.59 MB br).
- `runtime/config` and `discovery` already leave at parse time from `index.html` (`startEarlyDiscovery`), and so does `get-session` with a stored Bearer.
- The cause of the wait is `ui/apps/console/src/main.tsx`'s static import closure (`register-plugins.ts` importing plugin-grid and plugin-detail eagerly, the `register*Components` modules, the app-shell entry).

## Ask

Start the seed's `me/localization` at parse time in `index.html`, beside discovery (it needs discovery's `locale.supported`, already a parse-time read), and have `seedTenantLanguage` take that request. Keep ruling 6915665005 (#33985, letter B) and the bounded seed race unchanged. Pin it in `sessionCheckBootDedup.test.tsx` style: the seed request is issued before the entry module evaluates, and is sent once. About 100-150 lines. Shrinking the eager closure itself stays with #33581.

Serial: after slice 1 of #35455 lands (same files: `languageSeed.ts`, `index.html`).

⛔ Not a claim.
